translations.literal: (Chen Hao, Jiang Sheng.)
translations.idiomatic: (Appended biographies: Chen Hao and Jiang Sheng.)

translations.idiomatic: Chen Jin, Yu Jian, and Zhou Nan

sentences.zh: （孫祿）〉

translations.literal: (Sun Lu.)
translations.idiomatic: (Appended biography: Sun Lu.)

sentences.zh: 馬昊

translations.literal: Ma Hao
translations.idiomatic: Ma Hao.

sentences.zh: 何鑒，字世光，浙江新昌人。

translations.literal: He Jian, styled Shiguang, was a native of Xinchang in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He Jian, whose style was Shiguang, came from Xinchang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 成化五年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the fifth year of Chenghua.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifth year of Chenghua.

sentences.zh: 授宜興知縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Yixing.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Yixing county.

sentences.zh: 征拜御史，巡宣府、大同。

translations.literal: Summoned and appointed investigating censor, he inspected Xuanfu and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to serve as investigating censor and toured Xuanfu and Datong.

sentences.zh: 劾巡撫鄭寧以下數十人不職，按裨將孟璽等罪。

translations.literal: He impeached the grand coordinator Zheng Ning and dozens of subordinates below him for dereliction of duty, and prosecuted the assistant generals Meng Xi and others for their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Grand Coordinator Zheng Ning and dozens of officials under him for neglect of duty, and brought charges against Assistant Generals Meng Xi and others.

sentences.zh: 還巡太倉。

translations.literal: On returning he inspected Taicang.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he inspected Taicang.

sentences.zh: 總督太監卒犯法，逮治之，為所構，下錦衣獄。

translations.literal: A eunuch attendant of the grand coordinator broke the law; Jian arrested and tried him, was framed by the man, and was cast into the Embroidered Uniform Guard prison.
translations.idiomatic: When a eunuch attendant of the grand coordinator broke the law, Jian arrested and tried him; the man framed him, and he was thrown into the Embroidered Uniform Guard prison.

sentences.zh: 得釋，再按江北。

translations.literal: Released, he again conducted inspections in the region north of the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: After his release he again conducted inspections north of the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 鳳陽皇陵所在，近境取寸木，法皆死，陵軍多倚禁虐民。

translations.literal: The imperial tombs at Fengyang stood there; within the nearby districts taking even an inch of timber was punishable by death, and the tomb garrison troops often relied on the prohibition to abuse the people.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial tombs at Fengyang lay in that region; within the neighboring districts the law made even gathering an inch of firewood a capital offense, and the tomb garrison troops often abused the people by invoking the prohibition.

sentences.zh: 鑒請以山麓為限，他樵采勿禁，遂著為令。

translations.literal: Jian requested that the mountain foothills be taken as the limit and that woodcutting elsewhere not be forbidden; this was then enacted as an ordinance.
translations.idiomatic: Jian asked that the mountain foothills be set as the boundary and that fuel gathering elsewhere be permitted; the rule was then written into law.

sentences.zh: 出為河南知府。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as prefect of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as prefect of Henan.

sentences.zh: 振累歲饑，條行荒政十事。

translations.literal: Zhen suffered famine year after year; he set forth ten measures of famine relief policy.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture had suffered famine for successive years; he laid out ten measures for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 歷四川左、右布政使。

translations.literal: He successively served as left and right provincial administration commissioner of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as left and right provincial administration commissioner of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 弘治六年以右副都御史巡撫江南，兼理杭、嘉、湖三府稅糧。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Hongzhi he was made right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Jiangnan, and was also charged with managing the tax grain of Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Hongzhi he was appointed right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Jiangnan, and was also put in charge of the tax grain of the three prefectures of Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 蘇、松水災，用便宜發漕米十五萬石振之。

translations.literal: When Suzhou and Songjiang suffered flood damage, he used his discretionary authority to issue one hundred fifty thousand piculs of transport grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: When Suzhou and Songjiang were hit by floods, he exercised his discretionary powers to release one hundred fifty thousand piculs of transport grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 與侍郎徐貫疏吳淞、白茆諸渠，泄水入海，水患以除。

translations.literal: Together with Vice Minister Xu Guan he dredged the channels at Wusong, Baimao, and elsewhere so that the water drained into the sea, and the flood peril was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Vice Minister Xu Guan he dredged the Wusong, Baimao, and other channels to discharge water into the sea, and the flood menace was ended.

sentences.zh: 復巡撫山東，遷刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: He again served as grand coordinator of Shandong and was promoted to vice minister of justice.
translations.idiomatic: He again governed Shandong as grand coordinator and was promoted to vice minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 母憂去。

translations.literal: He left office on mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 十八年還朝。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he returned to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Hongzhi he returned to court.

sentences.zh: 時承平久，生齒日繁。

translations.literal: The realm had long been at peace and the population daily grew.
translations.idiomatic: The realm had long been at peace and the population grew daily.

sentences.zh: 孝宗覽天下戶籍數乃視國初反減，咎所司溺職，欲厘正之。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozong reviewed the empire's household registers and found the count actually lower than at the founding of the dynasty; he blamed the responsible offices for negligence of duty and wished to rectify the registers.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong reviewed the empire's household registers, the figures were actually lower than at the dynasty's founding; he blamed the responsible offices for dereliction and wished to rectify the registers.

sentences.zh: 敕鑒以故官兼左僉都御史往河南、湖廣、陜西閱實戶口。

translations.literal: He ordered Jian, in his former office and concurrently as left assistant censor-in-chief, to go to Henan, Huguang, and Shaanxi to verify household registers.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Jian, retaining his former rank and concurrently serving as left assistant censor-in-chief, to proceed to Henan, Huguang, and Shaanxi to verify household registers.

sentences.zh: 得戶二十三萬五千有奇，口七十三萬九千有奇，因疏善後十事及軍民利病以聞。

translations.literal: He found two hundred thirty-five thousand odd households and seven hundred thirty-nine thousand odd persons, and memorialized ten measures for follow-up governance together with benefits and harms to troops and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: He found two hundred thirty-five thousand odd households and seven hundred thirty-nine thousand odd persons, and memorialized ten follow-up measures together with benefits and harms affecting troops and civilians.

sentences.zh: 會孝宗已崩，武宗悉采納之。

translations.literal: It happened that Xiaozong had already died; Emperor Wuzong adopted them all.
translations.idiomatic: By then Xiaozong had already died; Emperor Wuzong adopted every proposal.

sentences.zh: 正德二年拜南京兵部尚書參贊機務。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengde he was appointed Minister of War at Nanjing with concurrent charge of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhengde he became Minister of War at Nanjing with concurrent charge of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 鑒前撫江南，嘗按千戶張文冕罪，文冕亡去。

translations.literal: When Jian had earlier governed Jiangnan he had prosecuted the thousand-household Zhang Wenmian for a crime; Wenmian had fled.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Jian had governed Jiangnan, he had prosecuted Thousand-Household Zhang Wenmian for a crime; Wenmian had fled.

sentences.zh: 至是構於劉瑾，而瑾亦嗛鑒不與通，遂坐以事連罰米。

translations.literal: By then he was framed by Liu Jin, and Jin also resented that Jian would not associate with him; Jian was therefore punished by being fined rice on a connected charge.
translations.idiomatic: By then he was framed through Liu Jin, who also resented Jian for refusing to deal with him; Jian was therefore fined rice on a connected charge.

sentences.zh: 貧不能償，奏訴獲免。

translations.literal: Too poor to pay, he memorialized in appeal and was exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Too poor to pay, he appealed in a memorial and was exempted.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，召為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year he was summoned to serve as Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year he was summoned as Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 時大盜並起，劉寵、劉宸、楊虎、劉惠、齊彥名、朱諒等亂畿輔；

translations.literal: At that time great bandits rose everywhere: Liu Chong, Liu Chen, Yang Hu, Liu Hui, Qi Yanming, Zhu Liang, and others threw the capital region into disorder;
translations.idiomatic: Great bandits rose on every side: Liu Chong, Liu Chen, Yang Hu, Liu Hui, Qi Yanming, Zhu Liang, and others threw the capital region into disorder;

sentences.zh: 方四、曹甫、藍廷瑞、鄢本恕等躪四川；

translations.literal: Fang Si, Cao Fu, Lan Tingrui, Yan Benshu, and others trampled Sichuan;
translations.idiomatic: Fang Si, Cao Fu, Lan Tingrui, Yan Benshu, and others ravaged Sichuan;

sentences.zh: 汪澄二、羅光權、王浩八、王鈺五等擾江西，皆稱王。

translations.literal: Wang Chenger, Luo Guangquan, Wang Haoba, Wang Yuwu, and others harassed Jiangxi, all styling themselves kings.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chenger, Luo Guangquan, Wang Haoba, Wang Yuwu, and others harassed Jiangxi, each styling himself king.

sentences.zh: 四方告急無虛日。

translations.literal: Alarms from the four quarters came in day after day without respite.
translations.idiomatic: Alarms from every quarter arrived day after day without respite.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書王敞不能辦賊。

translations.literal: Minister of War Wang Chang could not cope with the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of War Wang Chang could not cope with the bandits.

sentences.zh: 帝既命洪鐘、陳金、馬中錫督師分討。

translations.literal: The Emperor had already ordered Hong Zhong, Chen Jin, and Ma Zhongxi to take command in separate campaigns of suppression.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had already ordered Hong Zhong, Chen Jin, and Ma Zhongxi to take command in separate suppression campaigns.

sentences.zh: 其年五月，罷敞，以鑒代之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of that year Chang was dismissed and Jian replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: That fifth month Chang was removed and Jian took his place.

sentences.zh: 鑒乃選將練兵，錄民間材武士，令鄉聚悉樹柵浚溝，團結相救。

translations.literal: Jian then selected generals and trained troops, enrolled able-bodied men of martial talent from among the people, and ordered every village to erect palisades and dig ditches so that they might unite and rescue one another.
translations.idiomatic: Jian then selected generals, trained troops, enrolled able-bodied men of martial talent from among the people, and ordered every village to erect palisades and dig ditches so that neighbors could unite and rescue one another.

sentences.zh: 河南、山西兵守黃河，斷太行。

translations.literal: Troops from Henan and Shanxi guarded the Yellow River and blocked the Taihang passes.
translations.idiomatic: Troops from Henan and Shanxi guarded the Yellow River and blocked the passes of Taihang.

sentences.zh: 京操班軍，留守所在城邑。

translations.literal: Capital-training detachments remained to guard their local cities and towns.
translations.idiomatic: Capital-training detachments remained behind to guard their local cities and towns.

sentences.zh: 每漕艘運卒一人屯河濱，護運道，通行旅。

translations.literal: One transport-boat soldier from each grain convoy was stationed along the river to protect the transport route and secure travelers.
translations.idiomatic: One soldier from each grain transport convoy was stationed along the river to protect the transport route and secure travelers.

sentences.zh: 文武大吏軼賊，請敕峻責之，而褒縣令能擊賊者。

translations.literal: When civil and military grand officials let bandits escape, he requested stern imperial reprimands, while he commended magistrates who could strike down bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When civil and military grand officials let bandits escape, he asked for stern imperial reprimands, while he commended magistrates who could strike bandits down.

sentences.zh: 以中錫玩寇，奏遣陸完代還，調邊將從完討賊。

translations.literal: Because Zhongxi had been lax toward the bandits, he memorialized to send Lu Wan to replace him and return, and transferred frontier generals to follow Wan in suppressing the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Finding Zhongxi lax toward the bandits, he memorialized to send Lu Wan to replace him and return, and transferred frontier generals to follow Wan in suppressing the bandits.

sentences.zh: 賊連為邊軍所破，奔迸四出。

translations.literal: The bandits were repeatedly broken by frontier troops and fled in all directions.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier troops broke the bandits again and again, and they fled in all directions.

sentences.zh: 會中官谷大用、伏羌伯毛銳率師駐臨清，賊遂謀以十二月朔伺帝省牲南郊，乘間犯駕，先一日趨霸州。

translations.literal: Meanwhile the eunuch Gu Dayong and the nobility-holder Mao Rui led troops stationed at Linqing; the bandits then plotted on the first day of the twelfth month, when the Emperor would inspect the sacrificial victim south of the suburban altar, to seize the chance to strike at the imperial procession, and one day earlier they hastened toward Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the eunuch Gu Dayong and the nobility-holder Mao Rui led troops stationed at Linqing; the bandits then plotted that on the first day of the twelfth month, when the Emperor would inspect the sacrificial victim south of the suburban altar, they would seize the chance to strike at the imperial procession, and one day earlier they hastened toward Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 鑒立奏聞，夜設備。

translations.literal: Jian immediately memorialized the court and by night made preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Jian immediately memorialized the court and made preparations through the night.

sentences.zh: 厥明，帝召問鑒。

translations.literal: At dawn the Emperor summoned Jian for questioning.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the Emperor summoned Jian to question him.

sentences.zh: 鑒請早出安人心，遂成禮而還。

translations.literal: Jian asked that the Emperor set out early to reassure the people's hearts; the rites were then completed and the Emperor returned.
translations.idiomatic: Jian asked that the Emperor set out early to steady the people's hearts; the rites were then completed and the Emperor returned.

sentences.zh: 賊知有備，西掠保定諸州縣以去。

translations.literal: Learning that preparations had been made, the bandits raided west through Baoding and the other prefectures and counties and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that preparations had been made, the bandits raided west through Baoding and the other prefectures and counties, then departed.

sentences.zh: 河南巡撫鄧璋請濟師，鑒言：「山東賊不及萬，官軍奚啻十倍。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Deng Zhang of Henan requested reinforcements; Jian said: "The bandits in Shandong number fewer than ten thousand, while government troops are more than ten times as many.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Zhang, grand coordinator of Henan, asked for reinforcements; Jian replied: "The bandits in Shandong number fewer than ten thousand, while government troops are more than ten times as many.

sentences.zh: 緣勢要私人營充頭目，撓律攘功，失將士心。

translations.literal: Because men serving powerful private interests were installed as unit leaders, they obstructed regulations and seized credit, and the officers and soldiers lost heart.
translations.idiomatic: Because men serving powerful private interests were installed as unit leaders, they obstructed regulations and seized credit, and officers and soldiers lost heart.

sentences.zh: 請盡遣若屬還。

translations.literal: I ask that all such persons be sent back.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that all such persons be sent back home.

sentences.zh: 都指揮以下失事，即軍前行戮。

translations.literal: Regional commanders and below who fail in their duties should be executed on the spot before the army.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders and below who fail in their duties should be executed before the army on the spot.

sentences.zh: 益調邊軍助璋。

translations.literal: Frontier troops should also be further transferred to assist Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Additional frontier troops should also be transferred to assist Zhang.

sentences.zh: 」帝悉從之。

translations.literal: "The Emperor adopted everything.
translations.idiomatic: "The Emperor adopted every proposal.

sentences.zh: 尋以捷書屢聞，加鑒太子少保。

translations.literal: Before long reports of victory came in repeatedly, and Jian was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Before long reports of victory came in repeatedly, and Jian was given the additional title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，賊突霸州，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year the bandits suddenly struck Bazhou and the capital went on alert.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the next year the bandits suddenly struck Bazhou and the capital was put on alert.

sentences.zh: 鑒令邊兵亟邀賊，賊遁去。

translations.literal: Jian ordered frontier troops to intercept the bandits at once; the bandits fled.
translations.idiomatic: Jian ordered frontier troops to intercept them at once; the bandits fled.

sentences.zh: 賊渠楊虎、朱諒死，其黨分擾山東、河南。

translations.literal: The bandit chiefs Yang Hu and Zhu Liang died, and their followers scattered to harass Shandong and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Bandit chiefs Yang Hu and Zhu Liang died, and their followers scattered to raid Shandong and Henan.

sentences.zh: 鑒以山東賊劉寵、劉宸、齊彥名等，責邊將許泰、郤永、劉暉、李鋐；

translations.literal: For the Shandong bandits Liu Chong, Liu Chen, Qi Yanming, and others, Jian held the frontier generals Xu Tai, Xi Yong, Liu Hui, and Li Qian responsible;
translations.idiomatic: For the Shandong bandits Liu Chong, Liu Chen, Qi Yanming, and the rest, Jian held Xu Tai, Xi Yong, Liu Hui, and Li Qian responsible;

sentences.zh: 以河南賊劉惠、趙鐩、刑老虎等，責邊將馮禎、時源、神周、金輔。

translations.literal: for the Henan bandits Liu Hui, Zhao Zhen, Xing Laohu, and others, he held the frontier generals Feng Zhen, Shi Yuan, Shen Zhou, and Jin Fu responsible.
translations.idiomatic: for the Henan bandits Liu Hui, Zhao Zhen, Xing Laohu, and the rest, he held Feng Zhen, Shi Yuan, Shen Zhou, and Jin Fu responsible.

sentences.zh: 未幾，毛銳敗績，與大用俱召還。

translations.literal: Before long Mao Rui suffered defeat and was recalled together with Dayong.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Mao Rui was defeated and recalled together with Dayong.

sentences.zh: 鑒乃請用彭澤，與仇鉞同辦河南賊，而以山東賊專委陸完。

translations.literal: Jian then requested the appointment of Peng Ze, who together with Qiu Yue would handle the Henan bandits, while the Shandong bandits were entrusted solely to Lu Wan.
translations.idiomatic: Jian then asked that Peng Ze be appointed, who together with Qiu Yue would handle the Henan bandits, while the Shandong bandits were entrusted solely to Lu Wan.

sentences.zh: 五月，河南賊平。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the Henan bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifth month the Henan bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 七月，山東余賊亦平。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the remaining bandits in Shandong were also pacified.
translations.idiomatic: By the seventh month the remaining bandits in Shandong were pacified as well.

sentences.zh: 陳金、洪鐘亦以次平江西、四川諸賊。

translations.literal: Chen Jin and Hong Zhong also in turn pacified the bandits of Jiangxi and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jin and Hong Zhong also pacified the bandits of Jiangxi and Sichuan in turn.

sentences.zh: 帝喜，加鑒太子太保，蔭子錦衣世百戶。

translations.literal: The Emperor rejoiced, gave Jian the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and ennobled his son as hereditary hundred-household commander in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rejoiced, gave Jian the additional title of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and ennobled his son as hereditary hundred-household commander in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

sentences.zh: 鑒乃上言：「群盜蕩平，民罹兵久，乞量免田租，多方振贍。

translations.literal: Jian then memorialized: "The mass of bandits has been swept away; the people have long suffered from warfare. I beg that field rents be reduced in measure, and that relief be provided by many means.
translations.idiomatic: Jian then memorialized: "The mass of bandits has been swept away; the people have long suffered from warfare. I beg that field rents be reduced in measure and that relief be provided by many means.

sentences.zh: 黜貪殘長吏，停不急工役。

translations.literal: Remove greedy and cruel senior officials; halt non-urgent labor corvées.
translations.idiomatic: Remove greedy and cruel senior officials; halt labor corvées that are not urgent.

sentences.zh: 還民故業，貸以牛種，復其家三年。

translations.literal: Restore the people to their former occupations, lend them oxen and seed, and exempt their households for three years.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the people be restored to their former occupations, that oxen and seed be lent them, and that their households be exempted for three years.

sentences.zh: 有訐舊事及怙惡者，並置於理。

translations.literal: Those who denounce old wrongs or cling to evil should all be brought to justice.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who denounced old wrongs or clung to evil should be brought to justice.

sentences.zh: 」帝悉報可。

translations.literal: "The Emperor approved all.
translations.idiomatic: "The Emperor approved all of it.

sentences.zh: 先是，七月中，鑒以群盜未盡，請留邊將劉暉戍山東，時源戍河南，郤永戍畿輔，李鋐戍淮、揚，各假總兵之職，俟事寧始罷。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the seventh month, because the mass of bandits was not yet exhausted Jian had requested that the frontier general Liu Hui remain to garrison Shandong, Shi Yuan garrison Henan, Xi Yong garrison the capital region, and Li Qian garrison Huai and Yang, each on temporary appointment as regional commander until affairs were settled and only then dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the seventh month, because the mass of bandits was not yet exhausted Jian had asked that the frontier general Liu Hui remain to garrison Shandong, Shi Yuan garrison Henan, Xi Yong garrison the capital region, and Li Qian garrison Huai and Yang, each on temporary appointment as regional commander until affairs were settled and only then dismissed.

sentences.zh: 仇鉞言，邊軍久勞，風土不習，人馬俱病。

translations.literal: Qiu Yue said that the frontier troops had long labored, were unaccustomed to the climate, and both men and horses were ill.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Yue said that the frontier troops had long labored, were unaccustomed to the climate, and that both men and horses were ill.

sentences.zh: 今賊已漸平，請留三之一討賊，余悉遣還。

translations.literal: Now that the bandits were gradually pacified, he asked that one third be kept to suppress bandits and the rest all sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the bandits were gradually pacified, he asked that one third be kept to suppress bandits and that the rest all be sent back.

sentences.zh: 廷議，二人議俱是，請四將各千人鎮壓，他將許泰、神周、金輔、溫恭輩俱統所部還邊鎮。

translations.literal: In court deliberation both men's proposals were held correct; it was requested that each of the four generals keep one thousand men to maintain order, while the other generals Xu Tai, Shen Zhou, Jin Fu, Wen Gong, and the rest should all lead their commands back to the frontier garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In court deliberation both proposals were held correct; it was requested that each of the four generals keep one thousand men to maintain order, while the other generals Xu Tai, Shen Zhou, Jin Fu, Wen Gong, and the rest should all lead their commands back to the frontier garrisons.

sentences.zh: 帝許之，命延綏軍徑還，遼東、宣府，大同軍過闕勞賜。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved; Yan-sui troops were to return directly, while Liaodong, Xuanfu, and Datong troops were to pass the capital to be rewarded after labor.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved; Yan-sui troops were to return directly, while Liaodong, Xuanfu, and Datong troops were to pass the capital to be rewarded after their labor.

sentences.zh: 帝時好弄兵。

translations.literal: The Emperor at that time delighted in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Emperor delighted in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 群小寵幸者言邊軍憨健過京軍遠甚，宜留之京營。

translations.literal: Petty favorites said that frontier troops were far more sturdy and keen than capital troops and ought to be kept in the capital garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Petty favorites said that frontier troops were far sturdier and keener than capital troops and ought to be kept in the capital garrison.

sentences.zh: 帝以為然。

translations.literal: The Emperor thought this right.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor thought this correct.

sentences.zh: 至十一月，三鎮軍畢至，遂命留之，以京軍往代。

translations.literal: By the eleventh month the troops of the three garrisons had all arrived, and he then ordered them retained and capital troops sent to replace them.
translations.idiomatic: By the eleventh month the troops of the three garrisons had all arrived, and he then ordered them retained while capital troops were sent to replace them.

sentences.zh: 鑒力陳不可，廷臣集議，復極言其害，帝竟不從。

translations.literal: Jian strongly argued that this could not be done; court ministers assembled in deliberation and again spoke at length of the harm, yet the Emperor in the end would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Jian argued strongly that this must not be done; the court ministers met and again set forth the harm at length, yet the Emperor would not agree.

sentences.zh: 自是，邊軍於大內團操，號為「外四家軍」，而江彬進用矣。

translations.literal: From this time frontier troops drilled in formation within the inner palace, styled the "Four Outer Household Armies," and Jiang Bin came into employment.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth frontier troops drilled in formation within the inner palace, called the "Four Outer Household Armies," and Jiang Bin came into power.

sentences.zh: 八年，宣府送迤北降人脫脫太等至京，命充禦馬監勇士。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Xuanfu sent the surrendered northerner Tuotuotai and others to the capital; the Emperor ordered them enrolled as warriors of the Imperial Stud Office.
translations.idiomatic: That year Xuanfu presented the surrendered northerner Tuotuotai and his party at court, and the Emperor enrolled them as warriors of the Imperial Stud Office.

sentences.zh: 鑒等上言：「漢、魏徙氐、羌於關中，郭欽、江統皆勸晉武早絕亂階。

translations.literal: Jian and others memorialized: "In Han and Wei the Di and Qiang were moved into the Guanzhong region; Guo Qin and Jiang Tong both urged Emperor Wu of Jin to cut off the source of disorder early.
translations.idiomatic: Jian and others memorialized: "Under Han and Wei the Di and Qiang were moved into Guanzhong; Guo Qin and Jiang Tong both urged Emperor Wu of Jin to cut off the source of disorder early.

sentences.zh: 苻堅處鮮卑於漢南，苻融亦慮其窺測虛實。

translations.literal: Fu Jian settled the Xianbei south of the Han, and Fu Rong also feared they would spy out weaknesses.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jian settled the Xianbei south of the Han, and Fu Rong too feared they would spy out weaknesses.

sentences.zh: 今使降人出入禁中，假寵逾分，且生慢侮。

translations.literal: Now to let surrendered men enter and leave the forbidden precinct and grant them favor beyond their station will moreover breed contempt.
translations.idiomatic: To let surrendered men now enter and leave the forbidden precinct and grant them favor beyond their station will only breed contempt.

sentences.zh: 萬一北寇聞之，潛使黠賊偽降，以為間諜，寧不為將來患哉？

translations.literal: Should northern enemies hear of this and secretly send cunning bandits to feign surrender as spies, would this not become a future calamity?
translations.idiomatic: Should northern enemies hear of this and secretly send cunning bandits to feign surrender as spies, would this not become a calamity in future?

sentences.zh: 」帝不聽。

translations.literal: "The Emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: "The Emperor refused to listen.

sentences.zh: 寧王宸濠謀復護衛，鑒力遏之。

translations.literal: The Prince of Ning, Zhu Chenhao, plotted to recover his guard troops; Jian strongly blocked it.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Ning, Zhu Chenhao, plotted to recover his guard; Jian blocked it resolutely.

sentences.zh: 都督白玉以失事罷，厚賄豹房諸幸臣求復，鑒執不從。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Bai Yu, dismissed for failure, bribed the favorites of the Leopard Quarter to seek reinstatement; Jian firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Bai Yu, dismissed for failure, bribed the Leopard Quarter favorites to seek reinstatement; Jian would not consent.

sentences.zh: 諸幸臣嗾诇事者發鑒家僮取將校金錢，言官遂交章劾鑒，致仕去。

translations.literal: The favorites incited investigators of offenses to expose Jian's household servants taking money from military officers; censors then submitted memorials in succession impeaching Jian, and he retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: The favorites incited investigators to expose Jian's servants taking money from officers; censors then impeached him in succession, and he retired.

sentences.zh: 閱九年卒，年八十。

translations.literal: Nine years later he died, aged eighty.
translations.idiomatic: Nine years later he died, at the age of eighty.

sentences.zh: 馬中錫，字天祿，故城人。

translations.literal: Ma Zhongxi, styled Tianlu, was a native of Gucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zhongxi, whose style was Tianlu, came from Gucheng.

sentences.zh: 父偉，為唐府長史，以直諫忤王，械送京師，而盡縲其家人。

translations.literal: His father Wei served as chief steward of the Tang princely establishment; for remonstrating bluntly he offended the prince, was put in cangues and sent to the capital, and his entire household was bound with ropes.
translations.idiomatic: His father Wei served as chief steward of the Tang princely establishment; for blunt remonstrance he offended the prince, was shackled and sent to the capital, and his entire household was bound with ropes.

sentences.zh: 中錫以幼免，乃奔訴巡按御史。

translations.literal: Zhongxi, spared because he was young, fled to appeal to the touring investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: Because he was still a child, Zhongxi was spared; he fled to appeal to the touring investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 御史言於王，釋其家。

translations.literal: The censor spoke to the prince, and the household was released.
translations.idiomatic: The censor spoke to the prince, and the family was released.

sentences.zh: 復奉母走京師訴冤，父竟得白，終處州知府。

translations.literal: Again he took his mother and went to the capital to plead the wrong; his father was finally cleared and ended as prefect of Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He again took his mother to the capital to plead the wrong; his father was finally cleared and ended as prefect of Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 中錫舉成化十年鄉試第一，明年成進士，授刑科給事中。

translations.literal: Zhongxi placed first in the provincial examination of the tenth year of Chenghua; the next year he passed the jinshi and was appointed supervising secretary in the Bureau of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxi topped the provincial examination in the tenth year of Chenghua; the following year he became a jinshi and was appointed supervising secretary in the Bureau of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 萬貴妃弟通驕橫，再疏斥之，再被杖。

translations.literal: The younger brother of Consort Wan, Tong, was arrogant and overbearing; twice he memorialized to denounce him and twice was beaten with the staff.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Wan's younger brother Tong was arrogant and overbearing; Zhongxi memorialized twice to denounce him and twice was beaten with the staff.

sentences.zh: 公主侵畿內田，勘還之民。

translations.literal: When a princess encroached on fields within the capital region, he surveyed and returned them to the people.
translations.idiomatic: When a princess encroached on fields within the capital region, he surveyed the lands and returned them to the people.

sentences.zh: 又嘗劾汪直違恣罪。

translations.literal: He also once impeached Wang Zhi for lawless arrogance.
translations.idiomatic: He also once impeached Wang Zhi for lawless arrogance and excess.

sentences.zh: 歷陜西督學副使。

translations.literal: He served in turn as vice education intendant of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as vice education intendant of Shaanxi province.

sentences.zh: 弘治五年，召為大理右少卿。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Hongzhi he was summoned to serve as right vice president of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Hongzhi he was summoned to the Court of Judicial Review as right vice president.

sentences.zh: 南京守備太監蔣琮與兵部郎中婁性、指揮石文通相訐，連數百人，遣官按，不服。

translations.literal: The Nanjing garrison eunuch Jiang Cong and Bureau of War director Lou Xing and commander Shi Wentong sued one another; several hundred persons were implicated; officials were sent to investigate but they would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanjing garrison eunuch Jiang Cong, Bureau of War director Lou Xing, and commander Shi Wentong sued one another; several hundred persons were implicated; officials were sent to investigate, but they would not submit.

sentences.zh: 中錫偕司禮太監趙忠等往，一訊得實。

translations.literal: Zhongxi went together with the Directorate of Ceremonial eunuch Zhao Zhong and others; in one inquiry the facts were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxi went together with the Directorate of Ceremonial eunuch Zhao Zhong and others; in a single inquiry the facts were obtained.

sentences.zh: 性除名，琮下獄抵罪。

translations.literal: Xing was removed from the rolls; Cong was cast into prison to answer for his crime.
translations.idiomatic: Xing was struck from the rolls; Cong was cast into prison to answer for his crime.

sentences.zh: 擢右副都御史，巡撫宣府。

translations.literal: He was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief and appointed grand coordinator of Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 劾罷貪耄總兵官馬儀，革鎮守以下私役軍士，使隸尺籍。

translations.literal: He impeached and dismissed the greedy and senile regional commander Ma Yi, and abolished the private use of soldiers by those below the garrison commander, making them return to the muster rolls.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached and dismissed the greedy, senile regional commander Ma Yi, and abolished the private use of soldiers by officials below the garrison commander, returning them to the muster rolls.

sentences.zh: 寇嘗犯邊，督軍敗之。

translations.literal: When bandits once raided the frontier, he supervised the troops and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits once raided the frontier, he supervised the troops and defeated them in battle.

sentences.zh: 引疾歸，中外交薦。

translations.literal: He cited illness and returned home; inside and outside the court he was recommended.
translations.idiomatic: He cited illness and returned home, and was recommended both within and outside the court.

sentences.zh: 武宗即位，起撫遼東。

translations.literal: When Wuzong took the throne he was raised to govern Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wuzong took the throne he was raised to govern Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 還屯田於軍，而劾鎮守太監朱秀置官店、擅馬市諸罪。

translations.literal: He restored garrison fields to the troops and impeached the garrison eunuch Zhu Xiu for establishing official shops, monopolizing the horse market, and other crimes.
translations.idiomatic: He restored garrison fields to the troops and impeached the garrison eunuch Zhu Xiu for establishing official shops, monopolizing the horse market, and other offenses.

sentences.zh: 正德元年入歷兵部左右侍郎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengde he entered court and served in turn as left and right vice minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhengde he came to court and served in turn as left and right vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 劉瑾初得誌，其黨朱瀛冒邊功至數百人。

translations.literal: When Liu Jin first gained his will, his follower Zhu Ying falsely claimed frontier merit for several hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Jin first gained power, his follower Zhu Ying falsely claimed frontier merit for several hundred men.

sentences.zh: 尚書閻仲宇許之，中錫持不可。

translations.literal: Minister Yan Zhongyu approved it; Zhongxi held that it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yan Zhongyu approved it, but Zhongxi held that it could not be done.

sentences.zh: 瑾大恚，中旨改南京工部。

translations.literal: Jin was greatly enraged; an imperial order from the palace changed Zhongxi to the Nanjing Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Jin was greatly enraged; an order from the palace changed Zhongxi to the Nanjing Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 明年勒致仕。

translations.literal: The next year he was compelled to retire.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was compelled to retire from office.

sentences.zh: 其冬，逮系詔獄，械送遼東，責償所收腐粟。

translations.literal: That winter he was arrested and cast into the imperial prison, sent in cangues to Liaodong, and charged to repay the spoiled grain he had received.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he was arrested, cast into the imperial prison, sent in cangues to Liaodong, and ordered to repay spoiled grain he had received.

sentences.zh: 逾年事竣，斥為民。

translations.literal: After more than a year the affair was concluded and he was dismissed as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year the affair was concluded and he was dismissed to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 瑾誅，起撫大同。

translations.literal: When Jin was executed he was raised to govern Datong.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin was executed he was raised again to govern Datong.

sentences.zh: 中錫居官廉，所至革弊任怨，以故有名。

translations.literal: Zhongxi in office was incorrupt; wherever he went he reformed abuses and bore resentment, and for this he had a reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxi was incorrupt in office; wherever he went he reformed abuses and bore resentment, and for this he won a reputation.

sentences.zh: 六年三月，賊劉六等起，吏部尚書楊一清建議遣大臣節制諸道兵。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year bandits Liu Liu and others rose; Minister of Personnel Yang Yiqing proposed sending a grand minister to command the troops of the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the sixth year bandits Liu Liu and others rose; Minister of Personnel Yang Yiqing proposed sending a grand minister to command troops on the various circuits.

sentences.zh: 乃薦中錫為右都御史提督軍務，與惠安伯張偉統禁兵南征。

translations.literal: He then recommended Zhongxi as right censor-in-chief to take charge of military affairs, and together with the Earl of Huian Zhang Wei to command the forbidden troops on a southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: He then recommended Zhongxi as right censor-in-chief to take charge of military affairs, together with the Earl of Huian Zhang Wei commanding the forbidden troops on a southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 劉六名寵，其弟七名宸，文安人也，並驍悍善騎射。

translations.literal: Liu Liu was styled Chong; his younger brother Qi was styled Chen; they were men of Wenan, both fierce and good at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Liu was styled Chong and his younger brother Qi was styled Chen; they were men of Wenan, both fierce and skilled at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 先是，有司患盜，召寵、宸及其黨楊虎、齊彥名等協捕，頻有功。

translations.literal: Earlier, because officials worried about bandits, they summoned Chong, Chen, and their followers Yang Hu, Qi Yanming, and others to assist in arrests, and they repeatedly had merit.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, because officials worried about bandits, they summoned Chong, Chen, and their followers Yang Hu, Qi Yanming, and others to assist in arrests, and they repeatedly won merit.

sentences.zh: 會劉瑾家人梁洪征賄於寵等不得，誣為盜。

translations.literal: It happened that Liu Jin's household retainer Liang Hong sought bribes from Chong and others and did not obtain them; he falsely accused them as bandits.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Liu Jin's household retainer Liang Hong sought bribes from Chong and others and failed to obtain them; he then falsely accused them as bandits.

sentences.zh: 遣寧杲、柳尚義繪形捕之，破其家。

translations.literal: Ning Gao and Liu Shangyi were sent to paint their likenesses and capture them, and their households were ruined.
translations.idiomatic: Ning Gao and Liu Shangyi were sent to paint their likenesses and hunt them down, and their households were ruined.

sentences.zh: 寵等乃投大盜張茂。

translations.literal: Chong and the others then joined the great bandit Zhang Mao.
translations.idiomatic: Chong and the others then threw in their lot with the great bandit Zhang Mao.

sentences.zh: 茂家高樓重屋，復壁深窖，素招亡命為逋逃主。

translations.literal: Mao's house had lofty towers and layered rooms, hidden passages and deep cellars; he had long recruited fugitives as masters of escape.
translations.idiomatic: Mao's house had lofty towers and layered rooms, hidden passages and deep cellars; he had long recruited fugitives as patrons of escape.

sentences.zh: 宦官張忠與鄰，茂結為兄，夤緣馬永成、谷大用、於經輩得出入豹房，侍帝蹴鞠，而乘間為盜如故。

translations.literal: The eunuch Zhang Zhong was his neighbor; Mao bonded with him as brothers, and through connections with Ma Yongcheng, Gu Dayong, Yu Jing, and others gained entry to the Leopard Quarter, attended the Emperor at kickball, and in spare moments continued as bandits as before.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Zhang Zhong was his neighbor; Mao bonded with him as brothers, and through Ma Yongcheng, Gu Dayong, Yu Jing, and others gained entry to the Leopard Quarter, attended the Emperor at kickball, and in spare moments continued as bandits as before.

sentences.zh: 後數為河間參將袁彪所敗。

translations.literal: Later he was several times defeated by Hejian Assistant Regional Commander Yuan Biao.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was several times defeated by Yuan Biao, assistant regional commander of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 茂窘，求救於忠。

translations.literal: Mao was cornered and sought rescue from Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: Cornered, Mao sought rescue from Zhong.

sentences.zh: 忠置酒私第，招茂、彪東西坐。

translations.literal: Zhong set wine in his private residence and summoned Mao and Biao to sit east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong set wine in his private residence and summoned Mao and Biao to sit facing east and west.

sentences.zh: 酒酣，舉觴屬彪字茂曰：「彥實吾弟也，自今毋相厄。

translations.literal: When the wine was heated he raised his cup and addressed Biao, saying of Mao: "Yanshi is my younger brother; from now on do not constrain one another.
translations.idiomatic: When the wine was heated he raised his cup toward Biao and said of Mao: "Yanshi is my younger brother; from now on do not constrain one another.

sentences.zh: 」又舉觴屬茂曰：「袁公善爾，爾慎毋犯河間。

translations.literal: " Again he raised his cup and addressed Mao: "Lord Yuan treats you well; take care not to offend Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: " He raised his cup again toward Mao: "Lord Yuan treats you well; take care not to offend Hejian.

sentences.zh: 」彪畏忠，唯唯而已。

translations.literal: Biao feared Zhong and could only assent.
translations.idiomatic: Biao, fearing Zhong, could only assent.

sentences.zh: 已，茂為寧杲所擒，寵等相率詣京謀自首。

translations.literal: Before long Mao was captured by Ning Gao; Chong and the others in succession went to the capital to plan surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Mao was captured by Ning Gao; Chong and the others went in succession to the capital to plan surrender.

sentences.zh: 忠與永成為請於帝，且曰：「必獻萬金乃赦。

translations.literal: Zhong and Yongcheng pleaded for them before the Emperor and said: "They must present ten thousand taels of gold before they are pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong and Yongcheng pleaded for them before the Emperor, saying: "They must present ten thousand taels of gold before pardon is granted.

sentences.zh: 」寵、宸不能辦，逃去。

translations.literal: " Chong and Chen could not manage it and fled.
translations.idiomatic: " Unable to raise the sum, Chong and Chen fled.

sentences.zh: 既而瑾誅，有詔許自首。

translations.literal: Later, when Jin was executed, an edict permitted voluntary surrender.
translations.idiomatic: After Jin was executed, an edict permitted voluntary surrender.

sentences.zh: 寵等乃出詣官。

translations.literal: Chong and the others then came out and reported to officials.
translations.idiomatic: Chong and the others then came out and reported to the authorities.

sentences.zh: 兵部奏赦之，令捕他盜自效。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War memorialized to pardon them and ordered them to capture other bandits to redeem themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War memorialized to pardon them and ordered them to capture other bandits as redemption.

sentences.zh: 寵等憚要束，未幾復叛。

translations.literal: Chong and the others feared restraint; before long they rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Chong and the others feared restraint and before long rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 黨日眾，所至，陷城殺將吏。

translations.literal: Their party daily grew; wherever they went they stormed cities and killed generals and officials.
translations.idiomatic: Their party grew daily; wherever they went they stormed cities and killed generals and officials.

sentences.zh: 中錫等受命出師，敗賊於彰德，既又敗之河間，進左都御史。

translations.literal: Zhongxi and others received orders to take the field, defeated the bandits at Zhangde, and again defeated them at Hejian; he was promoted to left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxi and others took the field under orders, defeated the bandits at Zhangde, and again at Hejian; he was promoted to left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 然賊方熾，諸將率畏懦，莫敢當其鋒，或反與之結。

translations.literal: Yet the bandits were then at their height; the generals for the most part were timid and would not meet their edge, or even joined with them.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the bandits were then at their height; most generals were timid and would not meet their edge, or even joined with them.

sentences.zh: 參將桑玉嘗遇賊文安村中。

translations.literal: Assistant Regional Commander Sang Yu once encountered the bandits in a village in Wenan.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Regional Commander Sang Yu once encountered the bandits in a Wenan village.

sentences.zh: 寵、宸窘蹙，跳民家樓上，欲自剄。

translations.literal: Chong and Chen were hard pressed, leaped into a commoner upper story, and wished to cut their own throats.
translations.idiomatic: Hard pressed, Chong and Chen leaped into a commoner upper story and wished to cut their own throats.

sentences.zh: 而玉素受賊賂，故緩之。

translations.literal: Yu had long received bribes from the bandits and therefore delayed.
translations.idiomatic: Yu had long taken bribes from the bandits and therefore delayed.

sentences.zh: 有頃，彥名持大刀至，殺傷數十人，大呼抵樓下。

translations.literal: Before long Yanming arrived holding a great blade, killed and wounded several dozen men, and shouted as he reached below the tower.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yanming arrived with a great blade, killed and wounded several dozen men, and shouted as he reached below the tower.

sentences.zh: 寵、宸知救至，出，射殺數人。

translations.literal: Chong and Chen knew rescue had come; they came out and shot and killed several men.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing rescue had come, Chong and Chen came out and shot and killed several men.

sentences.zh: 玉大敗。

translations.literal: Yu suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Yu suffered a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 參將宋振禦賊棗強，不發一矢，城遂陷，死者七千人。

translations.literal: Assistant Regional Commander Song Zhen resisted the bandits at Zaoqiang, did not loose a single arrow, and the city was then taken; seven thousand died.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Regional Commander Song Zhen resisted the bandits at Zaoqiang without loosing a single arrow; the city was then taken and seven thousand died.

sentences.zh: 當是時，寵、宸等自畿輔犯山東、河南，南下湖廣，抵江西。

translations.literal: At that time Chong, Chen, and others from the capital region raided Shandong and Henan, went south into Huguang, and reached Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Chong, Chen, and others from the capital region raided Shandong and Henan, swept south into Huguang, and reached Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 復自南而北，直窺霸州。

translations.literal: They again came from the south toward the north and directly threatened Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: They again swept from south toward north and directly threatened Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 楊虎等由河北入山西，復東抵文安，與寵等合，破邑百數，縱橫數千里，所過若無人。

translations.literal: Yang Hu and others from Hebei entered Shanxi, again came east to Wenan, joined Chong and the others, stormed a hundred-odd districts and counties, ranged over several thousand li, and wherever they passed it was as if there were no men.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Hu and others from Hebei entered Shanxi, again came east to Wenan, joined Chong and the others, stormed a hundred-odd districts and counties, ranged over several thousand li, and wherever they passed it was as if there were no one.

sentences.zh: 中錫雖有時望，不習兵。

translations.literal: Zhongxi, though he had reputation at the time, was not versed in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxi, though he enjoyed reputation at the time, was not versed in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 偉亦紈袴子，見賊強，諸將怯，度不能破賊，乃議招撫。

translations.literal: Wei too was a silk-breeches son; seeing the bandits strong and the generals timid, he judged they could not break the bandits and then discussed pacification by enlistment.
translations.idiomatic: Wei too was a pampered nobleman son; seeing the bandits strong and the generals timid, he judged they could not break the bandits and turned to pacification by enlistment.

sentences.zh: 謂盜本良民，由酷吏寧杲與中官貪黷所激，若推誠待之，可毋戰降也。

translations.literal: They said the robbers were originally good people, stirred up by the cruel official Ning Gao and greedy eunuchs; if treated with sincerity they could be made to surrender without fighting.
translations.idiomatic: They held that the robbers were originally good people stirred up by the cruel official Ning Gao and greedy eunuchs; treated with sincerity, they could surrender without fighting.

sentences.zh: 遂下令：賊所在勿捕，過勿邀擊，饑渴則食飲之，降者待以不死。

translations.literal: They then issued orders: where bandits were, do not capture; when passing do not intercept; if hungry or thirsty give food and drink; those who surrendered were to be treated as not subject to death.
translations.idiomatic: They then issued orders: where bandits were, do not capture; when passing do not intercept; if hungry or thirsty give food and drink; those who surrendered were to be spared death.

sentences.zh: 賊聞，欲就撫，相戒毋焚掠。

translations.literal: The bandits heard and wished to accept pacification, mutually admonishing one another not to burn and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing this, the bandits wished to accept pacification and admonished one another not to burn and plunder.

sentences.zh: 猶豫未定。

translations.literal: They hesitated and could not decide.
translations.idiomatic: They hesitated and could not reach a decision.

sentences.zh: 而朝廷以京軍弱，議發邊兵。

translations.literal: Meanwhile the court, because capital troops were weak, deliberated sending frontier troops.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile, because capital troops were weak, the court deliberated sending frontier troops.

sentences.zh: 中錫欲戰，則兵未集，欲撫，則賊時向背，終不得要領。

translations.literal: Zhongxi wished to fight but the troops were not yet gathered; he wished to pacify but the bandits at times turned this way and that, and in the end he could not grasp the essentials.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxi wished to fight but troops were not yet gathered; he wished to pacify but the bandits wavered, and in the end he could grasp no clear policy.

sentences.zh: 既建議主撫，不能變。

translations.literal: Having already proposed to make pacification the main policy, he could not change.
translations.idiomatic: Having already proposed to make pacification the main policy, he could not change course.

sentences.zh: 會寵等聞邊兵且至，退屯德州桑園。

translations.literal: It happened that Chong and others heard frontier troops were about to arrive and withdrew to camp at Sangyuan in Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that frontier troops were about to arrive, Chong and the others withdrew to camp at Sangyuan in Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 中錫肩輿入其營，與酒食，開誠慰諭之。

translations.literal: Zhongxi entered their camp in a shoulder carriage, gave them wine and food, and with open sincerity comforted and instructed them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxi entered their camp in a sedan chair, gave them wine and food, and with open sincerity comforted and instructed them.

sentences.zh: 眾拜且泣，送馬為壽。

translations.literal: The mass bowed and wept, and presented horses as a gift of longevity.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd bowed and wept and presented horses as a gift of longevity.

sentences.zh: 寵慷慨請降，宸乃仰天咨嗟曰：「騎虎不得下。

translations.literal: Chong generously asked to surrender; Chen then looked up to heaven and sighed: "Riding a tiger, one cannot dismount.
translations.idiomatic: Chong generously offered to surrender; Chen looked up to heaven and sighed: "Riding a tiger, one cannot dismount.

sentences.zh: 今奄臣柄國，人所知也。

translations.literal: Now eunuchs hold the state; this all men know.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs now hold the state — all men know it.

sentences.zh: 馬都堂能自主乎？

translations.literal: Can Vice Minister Ma act on his own?
translations.idiomatic: Can Vice Minister Ma truly act on his own?

sentences.zh: 」遂罷會。

translations.literal: " The meeting was then dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: " With that the meeting was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 而是時方詔懸賞格購賊。

translations.literal: Meanwhile an edict had just been issued setting a bounty to purchase the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile an edict had just been issued setting a bounty for the bandits' heads.

sentences.zh: 寵等偵知之，益疑懼，徑去，焚掠如故。

translations.literal: Chong and the others spied this out, grew more suspicious and fearful, went straight away, and burned and plundered as before.
translations.idiomatic: Chong and the others learned of this, grew more suspicious and fearful, went straight away, and burned and plundered as before.

sentences.zh: 獨至故城，戒毋犯馬都堂家。

translations.literal: Only when they reached Gucheng did they admonish one another not to offend Vice Minister Ma household.
translations.idiomatic: Only at Gucheng did they admonish one another not to harm Vice Minister Ma household.

sentences.zh: 由是，中錫謗大起，謂其以家故縱賊。

translations.literal: From this slander against Zhongxi greatly arose, saying that for his household sake he indulged the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: From this, slander against Zhongxi swelled, claiming he indulged the bandits for his household sake.

sentences.zh: 言官交劾之，下詔切責。

translations.literal: Censors in succession impeached him; an edict sternly reprimanded him.
translations.idiomatic: Censors in succession impeached him, and an edict sternly reprimanded him.

sentences.zh: 中錫猶堅持其說以請。

translations.literal: Zhongxi still firmly held to his view in his request.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxi still firmly held to his view in his memorial.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書何鑒謂「賊誠解甲則貰死，即不然，毋為所誑」。

translations.literal: Minister of War He Jian said: "If the bandits truly lay down arms then spare their lives; if not, do not be deceived by them.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War He Jian said: "If the bandits truly lay down arms, spare their lives; otherwise do not be deceived.

sentences.zh: 既而寵等終不降，乃遣侍郎陸完督師，而召中錫、偉還。

translations.literal: Before long Chong and the others in the end did not surrender; Vice Minister Lu Wan was then sent to supervise the army, and Zhongxi and Wei were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Chong and the others still would not surrender; Vice Minister Lu Wan was sent to supervise the army, and Zhongxi and Wei were recalled.

sentences.zh: 初，中錫受命討賊，大學士楊廷和謂楊一清曰：「彼文士耳，不足任也。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zhongxi received orders to suppress bandits, Grand Secretary Yang Tinghe said to Yang Yiqing: "He is only a literary man and is not fit for the task.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Zhongxi received orders to suppress bandits, Grand Secretary Yang Tinghe told Yang Yiqing: "He is only a literary man — unfit for the task.

sentences.zh: 」竟無功，與偉同下獄論死。

translations.literal: " In the end he had no merit and, together with Wei, was cast into prison and sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end he achieved nothing and, together with Wei, was cast into prison and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 中錫死獄中，偉革爵。

translations.literal: Zhongxi died in prison; Wei was stripped of his nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxi died in prison, and Wei was stripped of his nobility.

sentences.zh: 十一年，巡按御史盧雍追訟中錫冤，謂：「賊實聽撫，僉事許承芳忌之，潛請益兵，疑賊心。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Investigating Censor Lu Yong pursued the wrong done to Zhongxi, saying: "The bandits truly heeded pacification; Vice Commissioner Xu Chengfang envied this, secretly requested additional troops, and made the bandits suspicious.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Investigating Censor Lu Yong pursued Zhongxi wrong, saying: "The bandits truly heeded pacification; Vice Commissioner Xu Chengfang, envying this, secretly requested more troops and made the bandits suspicious.

sentences.zh: 及賊再受約，方至軍門，而檻車已就道矣。

translations.literal: When the bandits again accepted terms and had just reached army headquarters, the prisoner cart was already on the road.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits again accepted terms and had just reached headquarters, the prisoner cart was already on the road.

sentences.zh: 」朝廷乃復中錫官，賜祭，予蔭。

translations.literal: " The court then restored Zhongxi office, granted sacrifice, and gave hereditary privilege.
translations.idiomatic: " The court then restored Zhongxi office, granted him sacrifice, and awarded hereditary privilege.

sentences.zh: 陸完，字全卿，長洲人。

translations.literal: Lu Wan, styled Quanqing, was a native of Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wan, whose style was Quanqing, came from Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 為諸生。

translations.literal: He was a student of the local school.
translations.idiomatic: He was a licentiate of the local school.

sentences.zh: 中官王敬至蘇，以事庭曳諸生。

translations.literal: When the eunuch Wang Jing came to Suzhou, he dragged students into the courtyard over some affair.
translations.idiomatic: When the eunuch Wang Jing came to Suzhou, he hauled students into the courtyard over some affair.

sentences.zh: 諸生競起擊之，完不與。

translations.literal: The students rose together to strike him; Wan did not join.
translations.idiomatic: The students rose together to strike him, but Wan did not join.

sentences.zh: 惡完者中之，敬遂首列完名上聞。

translations.literal: Those who hated Wan slandered him; Jing then listed Wan's name first in reporting to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Those who hated Wan slandered him, and Jing listed Wan's name first when reporting to the throne.

sentences.zh: 巡撫王恕極論敬罪，完乃得免。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Wang Su strongly argued Jing's crime, and Wan was then spared.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Wang Su strongly argued Jing's crime, and Wan was spared.

sentences.zh: 舉成化二十三年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi in the twenty-third year of Chenghua.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the twenty-third year of Chenghua.

sentences.zh: 謁選，恕方為吏部，曰：「是嘗擊奄人者，當為御史。

translations.literal: At audience for official selection, Shu was then Minister of Personnel and said: "This is one who once struck eunuchs — he ought to be made a censor.
translations.idiomatic: When he presented himself for appointment, Wang Shu was serving as Minister of Personnel and declared: "Here is the man who once struck the eunuchs — he should be made a censor."

sentences.zh: 」入臺，果有聲。

translations.literal: " He entered the Censorate and indeed gained a reputation.
translations.idiomatic: " Once in the Censorate, his reputation quickly followed.

sentences.zh: 正德初，歷江西按察使。

translations.literal: Early in the Zhengde reign he served through the post of Jiangxi surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhengde he rose to become Jiangxi surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 寧王宸濠雅重之，時召預曲宴，以金罍為贈。

translations.literal: The Prince of Ning, Chen Hao, greatly esteemed him, often summoned him to private banquets, and presented him with a golden wine vessel.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ning Chen Hao held him in high regard, frequently invited him to intimate feasts, and gave him a gold libation cup.

sentences.zh: 三年冬，擢右僉都御史，巡撫宣府。

translations.literal: In winter of the third year he was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-chief and made grand coordinator of Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: That winter in the third year he was elevated to Right Vice Censor-in-chief and appointed to oversee Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 劉瑾惡完赴闕後期，命以試職視事。

translations.literal: Liu Jin resented that Wan was late in arriving at court and ordered him to assume duties on a probationary appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jin took offense at Wan's tardy arrival at court and commanded him to serve in a provisional capacity.

sentences.zh: 明年夏，復改南院，督江防軍。

translations.literal: The next summer he was again transferred to the Southern Court to supervise river-defense troops.
translations.idiomatic: The following summer his post shifted to the Southern Court, where he directed the river-defense army.

sentences.zh: 完以都御史試職非故事，懼甚，賄瑾，召為左僉都御史。

translations.literal: Wan, because a censor-in-chief serving on probation was not precedent, was greatly afraid; he bribed Jin and was summoned as Left Vice Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing that a probationary censorate post broke precedent, Wan bribed Jin heavily and was recalled as Left Vice Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 五年春，拜兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In spring of the fifth year he was appointed Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year's spring he received appointment as Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 瑾敗，言者劾其黨附，帝不問。

translations.literal: When Jin fell, critics impeached Wan for factional attachment; the emperor did not inquire.
translations.idiomatic: After Jin's downfall, memorialists accused Wan of collusion, but the emperor took no notice.

sentences.zh: 明年，霸州賊劉六、劉七等起，奉楊虎為首。

translations.literal: The next year bandits Liu Six, Liu Seven, and others rose at Bazhou, acknowledging Yang Hu as leader.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Liu Six, Liu Seven, and fellow rebels erupted in Bazhou and set up Yang Hu as their chief.

sentences.zh: 惠安伯張偉、右都御史馬中錫師出無功，逮系論死。

translations.literal: Earl of Huian Zhang Wei and Right Censor-in-chief Ma Zhongxi led armies out without success and were arrested and sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: The Earl of Huian, Zhang Wei, and the Right Censor-in-chief Ma Zhongxi marched out to no avail and were seized and condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 八月，詔完兼右僉都御史提督軍務，統京營、宣府、延綏軍討之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month an edict made Wan concurrently Right Vice Censor-in-chief to superintend military affairs, commanding metropolitan, Xuanfu, and Yansui troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Wan was ordered to serve concurrently as Right Vice Censor-in-chief directing operations, uniting the metropolitan camp with Xuanfu and Yansui forces against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 行及涿州，忽傳賊且逼京師，命還軍入衛。

translations.literal: When he reached Zhuozhou, word suddenly came that bandits were about to threaten the capital; he was ordered to return the army to guard it.
translations.idiomatic: Marching as far as Zhuozhou, he was suddenly told the rebels were nearing the capital and commanded to wheel his troops back for its defense.

sentences.zh: 會副總兵許泰、遊擊郤永等敗楊虎等於霸州，賊南走，京師始解嚴。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Deputy Commander Xu Tai and guerrilla officer Xi Yong defeated Yang Hu and others at Bazhou; the bandits fled south and the capital's alert was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: By then Deputy Commander Xu Tai and guerrilla leader Xi Yong had routed Yang Hu at Bazhou; the rebels fled southward and the capital stood down from alert.

sentences.zh: 指揮賀勇等再敗賊信安，副總兵馮楨復大敗之阜城，分兵追擊。

translations.literal: Commander He Yong and others again defeated the bandits at Xin'an; Deputy Commander Feng Zhen again routed them at Fucheng, and troops were divided to pursue.
translations.idiomatic: Commander He Yong beat them again at Xin'an, and Deputy Commander Feng Zhen inflicted a still greater defeat at Fucheng before detachments were sent in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 賊東圍滄州。

translations.literal: The bandits besieged Cangzhou to the east.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels then laid siege to Cangzhou from the east.

sentences.zh: 會劉六、七中流矢，乃解而南，陷山東縣二十。

translations.literal: When Liu Six and Seven were struck by arrows, they lifted the siege and went south, capturing twenty Shandong counties.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Six and Liu Seven, wounded by arrows, broke off the siege and drove south, overrunning twenty counties in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 楊虎兵亦北殘威縣、新河。

translations.literal: Yang Hu's force also went north ravaging Weixian and Xinhe.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Hu's band turned north as well, laying waste to Weixian and Xinhe.

sentences.zh: 於是完頻請濟師。

translations.literal: Thereupon Wan repeatedly requested reinforcement.
translations.idiomatic: Wan thereupon pleaded again and again for additional troops.

sentences.zh: 益發遼東、山西諸鎮兵逐賊。

translations.literal: More troops from Liaodong, Shanxi, and other garrisons were sent to pursue the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Reinforcements were drawn from Liaodong, Shanxi, and other frontier commands to hunt the rebels down.

sentences.zh: 賊益南，圍濟寧，焚運舟，轉寇曹州。

translations.literal: The bandits pressed further south, besieged Jining, burned transport boats, and turned to raid Caozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels drove deeper south, encircled Jining, torched grain barges, and swung toward Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 楨、泰、永擊斬二千余人，獲其魁朱諒。

translations.literal: Zhen, Tai, and Yong struck and slew more than two thousand, capturing their chieftain Zhu Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Zhen, Xu Tai, and Xi Yong killed over two thousand rebels and seized their leader Zhu Liang.

sentences.zh: 錄功，進完右都御史，諸將皆增秩。

translations.literal: Merit was recorded: Wan was advanced to Right Censor-in-chief and all generals received rank increases.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards were entered on the rolls: Wan was promoted to Right Censor-in-chief and every commander gained a step in rank.

sentences.zh: 中官谷大用、張忠意賊旦暮平，乃自請督師。

translations.literal: Eunuchs Gu Dayong and Zhang Zhong thought the bandits would soon be pacified and themselves requested to supervise the army.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuchs Gu Dayong and Zhang Zhong, convinced the rebels would fall any day, volunteered to take command in person.

sentences.zh: 詔以大用總督軍務，伏羌伯毛銳充總兵官，忠監神槍，統京軍五千人，會完討賊。

translations.literal: An edict made Dayong grand coordinator of military affairs, Earl Fuxiang Mao Rui overall commander, Zhong supervising the divine guns, with five thousand metropolitan troops to join Wan in suppressing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The throne appointed Dayong grand coordinator, the Earl of Fuxiang Mao Rui as commander-in-chief, and Zhang Zhong over the firearm corps, sending five thousand capital troops to fight alongside Wan.

sentences.zh: 時劉六等縱橫沂、莒間，而楊虎陷宿遷，執淮安知府劉祥、靈璧知縣陳伯安，連陷虹、永城、虞城、夏邑及歸德州。

translations.literal: Then Liu Six and others ranged between Yi and Ju, while Yang Hu took Suqian, seized Huai'an prefect Liu Xiang and Lingbi magistrate Chen Bo'an, and in succession took Hong, Yongcheng, Yucheng, Xiayi, and Guide prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Six roamed between Yi and Ju while Yang Hu seized Suqian, took Huai'an prefect Liu Xiang and Lingbi magistrate Chen Bo'an prisoner, and overran Hong, Yongcheng, Yucheng, Xiayi, and Guide in turn.

sentences.zh: 邊兵追及，賊退至小黃河渡口。

translations.literal: Border troops caught up and the bandits retreated to the Little Yellow River ford.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing border troops pressed them back to the ford on the Little Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 百戶夏時設伏蹙之，虎溺死。

translations.literal: Company commander Xia Shi laid an ambush and pressed them; Hu drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Centurion Xia Shi sprang a trap and drove them hard; Yang Hu drowned in the river.

sentences.zh: 余賊奔河南，推劉惠為首，大敗副總兵白玉軍，攻陷沈丘，殺都指揮王保，執都指揮潘翀，北陷鹿邑。

translations.literal: Remaining bandits fled to Henan, made Liu Hui leader, severely defeated Deputy Commander Bai Yu's army, took Shenqiu, killed Commander Wang Bao, seized Commander Pan Chong, and north took Luyi.
translations.idiomatic: The survivors fled into Henan, raised Liu Hui as chief, shattered Deputy Commander Bai Yu's force, stormed Shenqiu, slew Commander Wang Bao, captured Commander Pan Chong, and pushed north into Luyi.

sentences.zh: 有陳翰者，與寧龍謀奉惠為奉天征討大元帥，趙鐩副之。

translations.literal: One Chen Han, with Ning Long, plotted to install Hui as Grand Marshal for Heaven's Campaign of Suppression, with Zhao Zan as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: A rebel named Chen Han joined Ning Long in proclaiming Hui Grand Marshal for the Suppression Campaign Mandated by Heaven, with Zhao Zan as his lieutenant.

sentences.zh: 翰自為侍謀軍國重務元帥府長史，與龍立東西二廠治事。

translations.literal: Han made himself Chief Secretary of the Marshal's Staff for Advising on Great Military and State Affairs, and with Long established eastern and western bureaus to conduct affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Han styled himself chief secretary of the marshal's staff for military and state planning, and he and Long set up eastern and western offices to run their regime.

sentences.zh: 分其軍為二十八營，以應列宿，營各置都督，聚眾至十三萬。

translations.literal: They divided their army into twenty-eight camps corresponding to the lunar mansions, each camp with a commander-in-chief, gathering forces to one hundred thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel host was split into twenty-eight camps to mirror the constellations, each with its own commander, until their numbers swelled to one hundred thirty thousand.

sentences.zh: 欲牽制官軍，於是惠、鐩擾河南，劉六及齊彥名等擾山東，黨分為二。

translations.literal: To tie down government troops, Hui and Zan harassed Henan while Liu Six and Qi Yanming harassed Shandong — the faction split in two.
translations.idiomatic: Seeking to pin down the government armies, Hui and Zan ravaged Henan while Liu Six and Qi Yanming terrorized Shandong, and the rebel cause divided in two.

sentences.zh: 已而六復轉而北，永敗之濰縣。

translations.literal: Before long Six turned north again; Yong defeated them at Weixian.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Liu Six veered north once more, only to be beaten by Xi Yong at Weixian.

sentences.zh: 還趨霸州，帝將出郊省牲，聞之懼，急召完赴援，完擊破之文安。

translations.literal: Returning toward Bazhou, the emperor was about to go to the suburbs to inspect sacrificial animals; hearing this he was afraid and urgently summoned Wan; Wan routed them at Wen'an.
translations.idiomatic: As they headed back toward Bazhou the emperor, preparing a suburban inspection of the sacrificial livestock, was seized with fear and urgently recalled Wan, who smashed them at Wen'an.

sentences.zh: 賊南至湯陰，完又督諸將追敗之，先後俘斬千人。

translations.literal: The bandits went south to Tangyin; Wan again supervised generals in pursuit and defeated them, capturing and slaying a thousand in all.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels pushed south to Tangyin; Wan once more directed his generals in pursuit, taking a thousand heads and captives between the engagements.

sentences.zh: 當是時，六等眾號數萬，然多脅從，精銳不過千余人。

translations.literal: At this time Six and the rest were said to number tens of thousands, yet most were coerced followers; crack troops did not exceed a thousand odd.
translations.idiomatic: By then Liu Six's host was claimed at tens of thousands, but most were pressed into service; his hardened fighters numbered barely a thousand.

sentences.zh: 自兵部下首功令，官軍追賊，賊輒驅良民前行，急則棄所掠逸去。

translations.literal: Since the Ministry of War issued the head-count merit rule, when government troops pursued, bandits drove innocent civilians ahead; pressed hard they abandoned loot and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Ministry of War began rewarding by heads taken, the rebels whenever pursued would drive commoners before them and, when hard pressed, cast aside their plunder and slip away.

sentences.zh: 官軍所殺皆良民，以故捷書屢奏，而賊勢不衰。

translations.literal: What government troops killed were mostly innocent people; hence victory reports were repeatedly filed yet bandit strength did not wane.
translations.idiomatic: The slain were often harmless villagers, so dispatches of victory multiplied even as the rebellion refused to fade.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，六等復突霸州，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Next year in the first month Six and others again burst into Bazhou; the capital went on alert.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year Liu Six and his fellows stormed Bazhou again, and the capital was placed under guard.

sentences.zh: 詔完及大用、銳還禦近畿，賊乃西掠博野，攻蠡縣、臨城。

translations.literal: Wan, Dayong, and Rui were ordered back to defend the near capital region; the bandits then raided west through Boye and attacked Lixian and Lincheng.
translations.idiomatic: Wan, Gu Dayong, and Mao Rui were recalled to shield the home provinces while the rebels swept west through Boye and struck at Lixian and Lincheng.

sentences.zh: 大用、銳與遇於長垣，大敗。

translations.literal: Dayong and Rui met them at Changyuan and were utterly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Dayong and Mao Rui encountered the rebels at Changyuan and suffered a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 廷議召二人還，別命都御史彭澤同鹹寧伯仇鉞辦河南賊，以畿輔、山東賊委完。

translations.literal: Court debate recalled the two; separately Censor-in-chief Peng Ze with Earl Xianning Qiu Yue were ordered to handle Henan bandits, entrusting capital-region and Shandong bandits to Wan.
translations.idiomatic: The court recalled the pair and assigned Censor-in-chief Peng Ze and the Earl of Xianning, Qiu Yue, to the Henan rebels, leaving the capital districts and Shandong to Wan.

sentences.zh: 完遣永追敗劉六於宋家莊。

translations.literal: Wan sent Yong to pursue and defeat Liu Six at Song Family Estate.
translations.idiomatic: Wan dispatched Xi Yong, who ran Liu Six down and defeated him at Song Family Estate.

sentences.zh: 賊南犯滕縣，副總兵劉暉大敗之，賊遂奔登、萊海套。

translations.literal: The bandits invaded south to Tengxian; Deputy Commander Liu Hui severely defeated them; they then fled to the coastal inlets of Deng and Lai.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels pushed into Tengxian in the south, where Deputy Commander Liu Hui broke them decisively and drove them toward the sea inlets of Deng and Lai.

sentences.zh: 完師次平度，檄永、玉與遊擊溫恭三道進攻，命副總兵張俊、李鋐及泰、暉分軍邀其奔逸。

translations.literal: Wan's army halted at Pingdu, ordered Yong, Yu, and guerrilla Wen Gong on three routes to attack, and commanded Deputy Commanders Zhang Jun, Li Gang, Tai, and Hui to divide forces and intercept their flight.
translations.idiomatic: Wan encamped at Pingdu, sent Xi Yong, Bai Yu, and guerrilla commander Wen Gong forward on three columns, and set Deputy Commanders Zhang Jun, Li Gang, Xu Tai, and Liu Hui to cut off their escape.

sentences.zh: 賊走，連戰皆大敗之，賊乃變服易馬而遁，先後擒斬二千六百余人。

translations.literal: The bandits fled; repeated battles all routed them severely; they changed clothes and horses to escape; in all more than twenty-six hundred were captured or slain.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels ran; battle after battle went against them until they swapped garments and mounts to flee, leaving more than twenty-six hundred killed or taken.

sentences.zh: 賊止三百人北走，沿途招聚，勢復張。

translations.literal: Only three hundred bandits fled north; along the way they gathered followers and their strength swelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Barely three hundred rebels escaped northward, yet they recruited along the road until their force swelled once more.

sentences.zh: 剽香河、寶坻、玉田，轉攻武清。

translations.literal: They raided Xianghe, Baodi, and Yutian, then turned to attack Wuqing.
translations.idiomatic: They plundered Xianghe, Baodi, and Yutian before wheeling to strike Wuqing.

sentences.zh: 遊擊王杲敗沒，巡撫寧杲兵亦敗，畿輔復震動。

translations.literal: Guerrilla Wang Gao was defeated and lost; Grand Coordinator Ning Gao's troops also lost; the capital region was shaken again.
translations.idiomatic: Guerrilla commander Wang Gao was wiped out, Grand Coordinator Ning Gao's men were beaten as well, and the home provinces trembled anew.

sentences.zh: 而賊轉南至冠縣，暉襲敗之，指揮張勛又敗之平原。

translations.literal: The bandits turned south to Guanxian; Hui surprised and defeated them; Commander Zhang Xun again defeated them at Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels veered south to Guanxian, where Liu Hui surprised and routed them, and Commander Zhang Xun beat them again on the plain of Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 賊南奔邳州，渡河抵固始。

translations.literal: The bandits fled south to Pizhou, crossed the river and reached Gushi.
translations.idiomatic: They raced south to Pizhou, crossed the river, and made for Gushi.

sentences.zh: 會河南賊已平，劉六等勢益衰，遂走湖廣。

translations.literal: As Henan bandits were already pacified, Liu Six and others grew weaker and fled to Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: With the Henan rebels already crushed, Liu Six and his band weakened and took flight into Huguang.

sentences.zh: 奪舟到夏口，遇都御史馬炳然，殺之。

translations.literal: Seizing boats they reached Xiakou, met Censor-in-chief Ma Bingran, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: They commandeered boats to Xiakou, where they encountered Censor-in-chief Ma Bingran and slew him.

sentences.zh: 復登陸，焚漢口，為指揮滿弼等追及，劉六中流矢，與子仲淮赴水死。

translations.literal: Again going ashore they burned Hankou; pursued by Commander Man Bi and others; Liu Six was struck by an arrow and he and his son Zhonghuai threw themselves into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: Back on land they torched Hankou until Commander Man Bi and others overtook them; Liu Six took an arrow and he and his son Zhonghuai drowned themselves.

sentences.zh: 劉七、齊彥名率五百人舟行，自黃州順流抵鎮江。

translations.literal: Liu Seven and Qi Yanming led five hundred men by boat, from Huangzhou downstream to Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Seven and Qi Yanming, with five hundred men in boats, drifted down from Huangzhou to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 南京告急，完疾趨而南。

translations.literal: Nanjing reported emergency; Wan hurried south.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing sounded the alarm, and Wan raced southward.

sentences.zh: 帝命彭澤、仇鉞會完軍進剿。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Peng Ze and Qiu Yue to join Wan's army in advance suppression.
translations.idiomatic: The throne commanded Peng Ze and Qiu Yue to unite with Wan's forces for the final campaign.

sentences.zh: 大兵盡集江南、北，賊猶乘潮上下肆掠。

translations.literal: Great forces gathered south and north of the Yangtze, yet bandits still rode the tides up and down plundering freely.
translations.idiomatic: Armies massed on both banks of the Yangtze, yet the rebels still rode the tides to raid up and down the river.

sentences.zh: 操江武靖伯趙弘澤、都御史陳世良遇之，敗績，死者無算。

translations.literal: River-defense Earl Wujing Zhao Hongze and Censor-in-chief Chen Shiliang met them, suffered defeat, and the dead were beyond counting.
